public_rationale: Google reported more than 650 million monthly active Gemini app users on October 29, 2025, exceeding 500 million before the deadline. This contradicts the statement when assessed as a prediction that the target would be missed.
limitations: The count is company-reported; the cited disclosure does not provide an independent audit or detailed deduplication methodology.
Meeting the target does not establish that it was a likely outcome when Zitron wrote, or that Gemini was profitable.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Gemini reaching 500 million users before the end of 2025 is unrealistic.

statement.excerpt: Sundar Pichai wants Gemini to be "used by 500 million people before the end of 2025," a number so unrealistic that someone at Google should have been fired, and that someone is Sundar Pichai.

from_speaker: used by 500 million people before the end of 2025
our_interpretation: Following the supplied forecast framing, read this as expecting Gemini to miss the 500-million-user target. The statement about firing Pichai is not assessed.
Users means people using the consumer Gemini service across its app surfaces, not only installations of its mobile application.
Monthly active users is an ordinary measure of actual usage and is sufficient to establish that 500 million people used Gemini.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable user measurements establish that Gemini did not reach 500 million users by December 31, 2025. Silence or a missing announcement alone does not establish failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible dated disclosure establishes at least 500 million active Gemini users before the end of 2025.
